title: Act: Add createFsIo and use it in the CLI entry
summary: Build the ArtIo from default paths with injected fs and drop the empty-manifest fallback
description: Replace the cwd-relative entry block in generateArt.ts with an ArtIo built by createFsIo(defaultArtPaths(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))), fs).
acceptance_criteria: createFsIo returns assetsRoot and manifestPath from the given paths
readText on a missing manifest throws instead of returning an empty manifest
The entry block passes real node:fs functions into createFsIo

preserve: VITEST guard around the entry block

technical_constraints: Hard constraint: deterministic in-repo art only
definition_of_done: Entry block no longer references 'public/assets' strings or EMPTY_MANIFEST_TEXT

steps.action: Add import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'; keep existing node:fs imports.

Add exported FsLike interface { readFileSync(p: string, enc: 'utf8'): string; writeFileSync(p: string, d: Uint8Array | string): void; mkdirSync(p: string, o: { recursive: true }): void } and createFsIo(paths: ArtPaths, fs: FsLike): ArtIo. readText calls fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8') with no existence fallback; write calls fs.mkdirSync(dirname(path),{recursive:true}) then fs.writeFileSync(path,data).
Replace the body with runGenerateArt(createFsIo(defaultArtPaths(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))), { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync })); remove the unused existsSync import.
steps.expected: CLI uses the app manifest and assets paths regardless of cwd
